decisions.reason: As a newly launched flagship product line that is very close to the core practice software business and fits the firm's push toward digital, connected workflows, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.

Training and continuing education reinforce the firm's software, support, and customer relationships, so management would usually keep and develop this complementary offer rather than exit after one year.

A remote screen-sharing support tool directly supports implementation and customer service, and although it is less distinctive than the flagship products, a growing software firm would normally retain it as a useful add-on.
